project_identity.name: Mqulima Africa Forum Upgrade
project_identity.tagline: World-Class Agriculture Ecosystem Forum & Knowledge Network
project_identity.theme_archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Local Relevance) with Precision Mobile Utility
project_identity.context: React Native (Expo) forum upgrade preserving Mqulima brand identity while modernizing UX, navigation, searching, topic filtering, sorting, card typography, thread details, comments, and post creation.

design_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Merge high-density modern discussion feeds (Reddit/Discourse style) with warm, tactile African agricultural aesthetics (Forest Greens, Ochre, Sand, Lime accents).
Emotion First: Every discussion card feels like a community gather place under a Baobab tree — welcoming, trustworthy, and actionable for real farmers.
Content Hierarchy & Clarity: High contrast text, legible metadata in monospaced/clean typography, clear visual distinction for original post author (OP), tags, and location stamps.
Zero Visual Monotony: Asymmetric cards, horizontal pill carousels, subtle 1px inner borders, and high-contrast micro-badges.
Frictionless Mobile Interaction: Keyboard-aware sliding composer sheets, quick horizontal tag filtering, one-tap thread bookmarking, and instant optimistic like updates.

h1.use_case: Forum Hero Banner Heading, Thread Detail Title

h2.use_case: Section Titles (e.g. Community Discussions, Agri Network)

body_main.use_case: Thread post main copy, comment body text

body_semibold.use_case: Author names, action button labels, form field labels

metadata.use_case: Timestamps, location tags, handle counts, status pills

bento_grid_rules: Thread list cards must have 16px horizontal margin and 12px vertical spacing.
Topic filter bar is horizontally scrollable with contentContainerStyle padding horizontal 16 and gap 8.
Thread card headers use flex direction row with avatar, author info column, and post category tag aligned to top right.
Media attachments inside thread cards use rounded corners (16px) with aspect ratio 16/10 to avoid screen hogging.
Comment list items are nested inside rounded surface cards with 12px padding and clear vertical connectors for thread depth.

features: Header Search & Filter Bar: Live search input with magnify icon, query clear button, and filter reset.
Topic Pill Bar: Horizontal filter pills (All, Maize & Grains, Horticulture, Livestock & Dairy, Pest & Disease, Market & Prices, Weather & Water) with active state in forest dark green and white text.
Sorting Tabs Bar: Toggle between 'Latest', 'Popular', and 'Unanswered' posts to help farmers quickly find urgent queries.
Quick Composer Banner: Compact avatar pressable banner with placeholder 'Share your farm update or ask a question...' that triggers creation flow.
Thread Feed: Optimistic FlatList with pull-to-refresh, skeleton loaders, error states, and empty search results view.
Agri Network Sidebar / Widget: Highlights top active community members and their counties.
Floating Action Button (FAB): Fixed bottom-right elevated green button with '+' icon for 1-tap post creation.
Header: Author avatar, bold author name, county location pill, handle & time.
Category Pill: High contrast category tag pill (e.g., '🌽 Maize', '🐛 Pest Control').
Body Content: Up to 4 lines of rich post text preview in Jakarta-400 with 'Read more' affordance.
Attachment Image: Optional image preview with soft border and subtle dark background fallback.

Actions Bar: Modern border-top divider with 3 main actions — Like (heart icon + optimistic increment counter), Comments (chat bubble icon + comment count), Bookmark (bookmark icon), and Share (copy link with toast feedback).
Full Hero Post Card: Expanded full view of thread with image zoom support.
Author Distinction: Special 'OP' (Original Poster) badge on comments written by thread creator.
Comments Section: Section header with total comment counter, nested reply tree styling, and empty state ('Be the first to reply').
Sticky Bottom Comment Bar: KeyboardAvoidingView with multi-line TextInput, media attachment icon, and active Send button.
User Profile Header: Displays author avatar, name, and county location.
Topic Selector: Flex-wrap tag chips allowing easy single selection.
Rich Text Field: Keyboard-aware multi-line text input with character count indicator.
Location Picker: Select county context to help local community answer.
Success Screen: Animated confirmation screen with direct action to view created post.

instructions_to_main_agent: Retain Mqulima's existing theme token structure in theme.ts while implementing the visual hierarchy described in this document.
Do NOT use fake engagement stats or synthetic online counts; use real threads and DB records.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, text inputs, filter pills, like buttons, sort tabs, share buttons) has a proper data-testid or testID attribute as specified in test_id_conventions.
Implement high quality empty, loading (ListSkeleton), and error retry states on the forum screen and thread detail screen.
Ensure the floating action button (FAB) is safely placed above bottom navigation tabs using useTabBottom().
Support topic filtering (All, Maize, Pest Control, Livestock, Irrigation, etc.) and search filtering dynamically in frontend state.
